title: sparse-usage-window-signal-loss-leading-to-invoice-time-holes
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem summary: several customers reported invoices with missing charge lines for short intervals (typically 3-12 minutes) during high-load bursts and concurrent rate-limit crediting. Investigation shows 'time holes' in the hourly export where no usage rows were emitted for a customer despite accepted requests. These gaps caused downstream Netsuite invoices to undercharge for a portion of the hour, then later generate corrective adjustments that confuse customers. Goal: make export generation and reconciler robust to sparse-window signal loss and ensure deterministic invoice line generation and backfill behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Export manifest contains explicit sequence numbers and per-customer watermark metadata for each hourly window
Reconciler fills gaps up to 15 minutes by deterministic backfill using raw request events and idempotent fingerprints
No duplicate or overlapping invoice lines produced for backfilled intervals (idempotency guaranteed)
Unit/integration tests cover DST transitions and multi-currency rounding for repaired lines
End-to-end shadow-run shows <0.01% net invoice delta vs baseline and all corrections are annotated in export reason field
reproduction_steps: 1) Load a copy of the usage event stream for a customer during a simulated burst window
2) Apply the current exporter to produce hourly export lines while deliberately dropping ~5-10 minute slices of events
3) Run current reconciler to produce Stripe/Netsuite lines and observe missing charge lines and later corrective credit lines
4) Validate that reconciler produces a corrective invoice the next cycle rather than a deterministic backfill
root_cause_summary: Intermittent worker GC spikes and a race in the aggregator checkpointing allowed short spans of raw events to be excluded from the hourly aggregation. The exporter emitted a manifest entry for the hour but the per-customer watermark for some customers advanced past the missing slices, making the downstream reconciler treat them as 'already-exported'. Additionally, rate-limit credit backfills were applied in a separate pass and lacked a stable fingerprint, generating non-idempotent corrective lines.
design_decisions: Introduce per-customer min/max event timestamps in the export manifest (watermark_low, watermark_high) as strings to make gap detection deterministic
Implement a 'short-gap backfill' mode in the reconciler that queries raw events when gaps <= 15 minutes and emits idempotent invoice lines with deterministic fingerprints
Keep full-gap behavior unchanged (quarantine and manual review) for gaps > 15 minutes to avoid aggressive retroactive billing
Add a fix that attaches the rate-limit-credit reason and original request fingerprint to credit lines so they can be matched deterministically
implementation_notes: Exporter: add watermarkLow/watermarkHigh fields to manifest schema and include per-customer counts
Aggregator: emit sub-minute histograms to help reconstruct sparse slices (coarser bucket if needed)
Reconciler: when manifest.watermarkHigh > manifest.watermarkLow + gapThreshold and exported_count == 0 then invoke short-gap backfill
Backfill: query raw events store (read-replica) with a fixed deterministic sort order, build invoice line fingerprint = sha256(customer_id + start_ts + end_ts + unit_price)
Ensure idempotency by storing generated_fingerprint in export_line_fingerprint column and skipping creation if exists
Add feature flag "short_gap_backfill_v2" for gradual rollout and shadow testing
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy exporter changes in canary region (us-west-2) behind feature flag; let it run for 48 hours and verify manifest fields
2) Deploy reconciler with backfill disabled but with enhanced logging to shadow-run the backfill logic for two billing cycles
3) Enable short-gap backfill for internal-only orgs and monitor invoice diffs for 3 cycles
4) Ramp to 25% of orgs, then 100% once SD/ops sign-off
5) Add a dashboard tile in Console showing number of backfilled lines and net revenue delta per day
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest parsing, gap-detection logic, and fingerprint generation
Integration tests that inject deterministic sparse windows and verify reconciler emits idempotent backfills
Shadow-run on production traffic for 7 days with backfill simulation off and compare to baseline reconciler output
End-to-end QA including Stripe test mode and a Netsuite sandbox ingestion to verify invoice line reconciliation
DR tests for clock skew and DST boundary (create synthetic events across DST changes and ensure deterministic behavior)
rollback_plan: Flip feature flag off to disable short-gap backfill and stop generating new backfilled invoice lines
If duplicate lines observed, run compensating job that de-duplicates by fingerprint and reverse extra lines with credit notes
Revert exporter manifest schema change is backward compatible; reconciler ignores new fields when feature flag off
